<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#4A4A4A" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">
    <text x="19" y="17">9:41</text>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="14"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="12"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="17" x2="336" y2="10"/>
    <path d="M345 13 Q350 8 355 13 M347 16 Q350 13 353 16"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="362" y="9" width="20" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="11" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#96E063"/>
  <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

  <!-- top app bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="25" width="390" height="65" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="89" x2="390" y2="89" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="29,57 21,57 28,50" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <polyline points="21,57 31,57" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="57" r="22" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="49" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="64" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="92" y="52" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">Lina</text>
    <text x="92" y="70" font-size="11" fill="#96E063">Active now</text>
  </g>
  <!-- call icon -->
  <g stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <polyline points="303,48 308,45 313,50 310,54 316,61 321,58 325,63 322,68 317,69 309,64 303,56 303,48"/>
  </g>
  <!-- video icon -->
  <g stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="337" y="50" width="17" height="14" rx="3"/>
    <polygon points="354,53 361,50 361,64 354,61" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- conversation area -->
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="195" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#939393">TODAY, JUNE 14</text>
  </g>

  <!-- incoming message 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="126" width="254" height="52" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#4A4A4A">
    <text x="34" y="148" font-size="14">Hey! I’m glad we matched 😊</text>
    <text x="34" y="166" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:32 AM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- outgoing message -->
  <rect x="135" y="191" width="237" height="52" rx="18" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="151" y="213" font-size="14">Me too! Your hiking photos</text>
    <text x="151" y="231" font-size="14">look amazing.</text>
  </g>
  <text x="345" y="257" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:34 AM  ✓✓</text>

  <!-- incoming message 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="276" width="290" height="71" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#4A4A4A">
    <text x="34" y="299" font-size="14">Thank you! I’m usually out on</text>
    <text x="34" y="318" font-size="14">the trails on weekends.</text>
    <text x="34" y="337" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:35 AM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- outgoing message 2 -->
  <rect x="116" y="365" width="256" height="52" rx="18" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="132" y="387" font-size="14">That sounds perfect. Have you</text>
    <text x="132" y="405" font-size="14">tried the Ridge Loop?</text>
  </g>
  <text x="345" y="431" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:37 AM  ✓✓</text>

  <!-- incoming message 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="445" width="276" height="71" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#4A4A4A">
    <text x="34" y="468" font-size="14">Not yet, but it’s on my list! I’m</text>
    <text x="34" y="487" font-size="14">free for coffee this week ☕</text>
    <text x="34" y="506" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:39 AM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- date prompt and latest reply -->
  <g>
    <rect x="135" y="537" width="237" height="52" rx="18" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="151" y="559" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">How about Thursday at 7?</text>
    <text x="151" y="577" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">I know a great little spot.</text>
  </g>
  <text x="345" y="603" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">10:41 AM  ✓✓</text>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="616" width="215" height="45" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="34" y="644" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#4A4A4A">Thursday works for me! 🎉</text>

  <!-- composer -->
  <rect x="0" y="674" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="674" x2="390" y2="674" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="709" r="14" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
  <line x1="27" y1="702" x2="27" y2="716" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="709" x2="34" y2="709" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="50" y="690" width="230" height="38" rx="19" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#EAEDF1"/>
  <text x="68" y="714" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Type a message...</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="290" y="690" width="82" height="38" rx="19" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="331" y="714" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">SEND</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polygon points="39,772 49,763 59,772 59,785 39,785" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="772" x2="49" y2="763"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="773" r="9"/>
    <line x1="119" y1="780" x2="133" y2="766"/>
    <polyline points="119,768 116,765 120,762 124,765"/>
    <polyline points="133,778 136,781 132,784 128,781"/>
    <rect x="197" y="764" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675"/>
    <polygon points="201,779 199,785 205,780" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="292" cy="770" r="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="292" cy="783" rx="11" ry="6"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="766" r="3"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="757" x2="350" y2="754"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="761" x2="340" y2="759"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="761" x2="360" y2="759"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="49" y="808" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
    <text x="126" y="808" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
    <text x="207" y="808" fill="#FE3675" font-weight="600">Chats</text>
    <text x="292" y="808" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
    <text x="350" y="808" fill="#939393">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
